issues.explanation: Change adds models, policies, middleware, two Livewire components and four routes with no Pest/PHPUnit tests, violating test-first and Livewire unauthorized/tamper test requirements.
current_entity middleware protects Livewire Dashboard but is never registered via Livewire::addPersistentMiddleware, so it stops applying on Livewire update requests.
CreateEntity performs Entity plus membership writes inside DB::transaction in the component instead of a dedicated app/Actions/* use-case class authorizing inside the action.
Public submit() validates input but never calls $this->authorize, violating the rule to authorize every Livewire action server-side.
POST entity.pick checks membershipFor and aborts 403 inline instead of authorizing through EntityPolicy/EntityMembershipPolicy via gates/policies.
Adds unrelated CI workflow tests.yml and an empty deploy-dev.yml that the task did not request.
Adds duplicate onboarding_title/onboarding_heading/entity_create_title/entity_create_heading/create_entity aliases beyond the required switch_entity plus create_entity_title/heading keys.
Middleware registers the tenant under both current.entity and current_entity container keys with no documented need for the duplication.

conventions.evidence: #[Validate]+validate() in CreateEntity.php:112,117 and $fillable/policy use are correct, but domain writes live in the component CreateEntity.php:127, no Livewire::addPersistentMiddleware for current_entity in bootstrap/app.php:532, pick route authorizes inline routes/web.php:898, and no tests ship

readability.evidence: Small focused methods with clear names e.g. Entity.php:253, uniqueSlug in CreateEntity.php:159, but duplicate lang aliases lang/en/ui.php:763 and dual app()->instance keys CurrentEntity.php:80-81 add confusion plus an empty deploy-dev.yml

requirements.evidence: entities_slug_unique + SoftDeletes + slug binding Entity.php:243/migration:641, owner_seq storedAs + entity_memberships_one_owner migration:683,687, policies EntityPolicy.php:486/EntityMembershipPolicy.php:441, middleware CurrentEntity.php:50,65, CreateEntity retry loop CreateEntity.php:123, Dashboard authorize Dashboard.php:206, switcher entity-switcher.blade.php:798, navbar default-page.blade.php:818, routes/web.php:870,890,894,898,917, docs/database-schema.md:730

scope.evidence: Core diff serves onboarding/session/switcher/dashboard, but .github/workflows/tests.yml:1 (11-line CI job) and empty .github/workflows/deploy-dev.yml:1 are unrelated additions

security.evidence: No unescaped output ({{ }} in entity-switcher.blade.php:802), mass-assignment via #[Fillable], validated name CreateEntity.php:112, but submit() lacks $this->authorize CreateEntity.php:115 and current_entity lacks persistent Livewire middleware bootstrap/app.php:532

simplicity.evidence: Lean reuse of Str::slug, Eloquent, policies and existing layouts, but extra tests.yml workflow, 4 extra lang aliases lang/en/ui.php:763-767 and dual app()->instance CurrentEntity.php:80-81 are unnecessary

tests.evidence: Diff contains no tests/* or updates to existing tests; happy-path, validation-failure, unauthorized-call and tamper tests for CreateEntity/Dashboard/pick/middleware are all missing

review.summary: Change implements the full entity data model, policies, tenant middleware, onboarding with slug retry, dashboard, switcher and docs correctly. It is blocked by zero shipped tests, missing Livewire persistent middleware for current_entity, and domain writes living in the Livewire component instead of an Action.
